Create a SharePoint document library

Source: R/sp_drive.R
create_sp_drive.Rd

create_sp_drive() creates a document library on a SharePoint site and returns the library's drive as a ms_drive object. A document library is a SharePoint list created with the "documentLibrary" template, so this function wraps create_sp_list(). Columns, views, and folders can be supplied with a list definition (see read_sp_list_yaml()).

The library's list can be used with the list functions (e.g. compare_sp_list() or sync_sp_list()) and the drive can be used with the file and folder functions (e.g. sp_dir_create() or upload_sp_item()).

create_sp_drive() doesn't create a SharePoint Embedded container (a Graph fileStorageContainer). Containers aren't part of a SharePoint site and can only be created by an app that owns a registered container type.

Usage

create_sp_drive(
  drive_name = NULL,
  description = NULL,
  ...,
  folders = NULL,
  definition = NULL,
  properties = FALSE,
  site_url = NULL,
  site = NULL,
  call = caller_env()
)

Arguments

drive_name

Library name used as the displayName property. SharePoint sets the library URL from this name, so the drive name and URL can't be changed separately. Required unless definition is supplied.

description

Optional description.

...

Additional parameters passed to create_sp_list() (e.g. columns, content_types, or hidden) and to get_sp_site() if site is NULL.

folders

Optional. A character vector of folder paths to create, relative to the library root (e.g. c("Reports/2026", "Data")). Parent folders are created as needed. Replaces any folders in definition.

definition

Optional. A list definition from read_sp_list_yaml() or a path to a YAML file. The definition list.template must be documentLibrary if it is set. See create_sp_list() for how the definition is used.

properties

If TRUE, return the drive properties instead of the ms_drive object. Defaults to FALSE.

site_url

A SharePoint site URL in the format "https://[tenant name].sharepoint.com/sites/[site name]". Any SharePoint item or document URL can also be parsed to build a site URL using the tenant and site name included in the URL.

site

A ms_site object. If site is supplied, site_url, site_name, and site_id are ignored.

call

The execution environment of a currently running function, e.g. caller_env(). The function will be mentioned in error messages as the source of the error. See the call argument of abort() for more information.

Value

A ms_drive object for the new library, or the drive properties as a named list if properties = TRUE.

See also

update_sp_drive(), delete_sp_drive(), create_sp_list(), get_sp_drive()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
create_sp_drive(
  "Project Files",
  folders = c("Contracts", "Reports/2026"),
  site_url = "<SharePoint site url>"
)

create_sp_drive(
  definition = "library-fields/project-files.yaml",
  site_url = "<SharePoint site url>"
)
} # }
